contractChanges.oldValue: Keep the book and its primary reading task dominant; use one quiet contextual connection control, a focused phone dialog with scan-first guidance and a direct return.
contractChanges.newValue: Keep the current passage legible and reachable, with operable contextual connection controls, focused QR/code guidance and direct return to the same Chronicle. Preserve an unobscured current heading and the existing substantive first-viewport reading-area and hit-test requirements. Editorial first-viewport dominance, utility grouping and appearance refinement are assigned to Project Refit; obstruction, unreadability and inaccessible controls remain Crossdeck blockers.

contractChanges.oldValue: Give each purpose its own full readable workspace beneath one Chronicle identity and connection status; make purpose change secondary and the return persistent, with camera-free meaningful Lens and actual map objectives.
contractChanges.newValue: Give each purpose its full readable workspace beneath one Chronicle identity and connection status, with discoverable, operable purpose selection and persistent unobscured return, camera-free meaningful Lens and actual map objectives. Editorial ranking and grouping of purpose/connection utilities and appearance refinement are assigned to Project Refit after all functional reading, purpose and return criteria pass.

contractChanges.oldValue: Keep the companion immersive, preserve compact account/context controls, and make the safe library exit and re-entry readable on desktop and phone.
contractChanges.newValue: Keep account/context controls and safe library exit and same-Voyage re-entry readable, discoverable and operable on desktop and phone in both motion modes. Relative passage/chrome composition after return and editorial appearance refinement are assigned to Project Refit; no functional, accessibility or continuity defect is deferred.

scopeAdjudication.requiredFunctionalScope: Essential readability and unchanged280x211 heading/hit-test/overflow, operable accessible controls, same-Voyage identity/edition/progression/return, actual purposes/Lens/maps/released content, privacy/security and truthful fallback; B2 and all other blockers remain fully resolvable requirements
